newsitem.title: USA: Cistron chairman quits after loan default.
newsitem.headline: Cistron chairman quits after loan default.

text.p: Cistron Biotechnology Inc said its chairman Henry Grausz resigned after he and a company in which he had a management role defaulted on a loan made by Cistron.
In a press release Wednesday, Cistron said its board voted Tuesday to delay until July 31 attempts to collect the loan.

Smith said Cistron described terms of the loan in a 10-Q filing with the SEC for the quarter ending March 31. He said the filing also noted Cistron had the right to convert the note into an 11.5 percent equity position in Rebuild "plus $115,000 from the profits of the borrowing company."
Cistron specializes in immune response regulators known as lymphokines. It makes and sells lymphokine assay kits for cancer, arthritis and other autoimmune disease research.
